academy-nav-hall.text: Academy navigation lecture hall — steep semicircle of cadet stations facing a large three-dimensional route table. Fleet blue structural ribs, Ion White work light, restrained gold trim, tactile training cords and real navigation hardware keep the room practical rather than ceremonial.

academy-sim-chamber.text: Academy Mirrorfold simulator — bridge-scale training chamber with physical handrails, tether points, inertial recorders and wraparound projection surfaces. The simulation can produce convincing reflected corridors and duplicated figures while the actual room remains physically stable.

glass-horizon-survey-docks.text: Glass Horizon Survey Docks — Lattice-facing expedition docks at the edge of stabilized space, with survey cutters, resonance struts, departure platforms and calm-eddy monitoring arrays. Functional Fleet survey architecture, not a luxury port.

far-lantern-bridge.text: RFV Far Lantern bridge — compact survey-cutter bridge built around pilot, navigation and systems stations. Wide forward viewport, redundant physical controls, tactile route board, tether lockers and restrained Fleet blue/white interior with gold crest details.

far-lantern-lock.text: RFV Far Lantern field lock — narrow equipment bay with paired tethers, rescue harnesses, resonance tools, pressure suits and an exterior hatch sized for survey work rather than combat boarding.

mirrorfold-fracture-chamber.text: Mirrorfold fracture chamber — vast hall-like volume of folded reflective planes, dark void between luminous edges, Nova Blue and Plasma Violet refractions, repeating stars and apparent corridors. A true physical path exists through the chamber but visual perspective alone cannot reliably reveal it.

mirrorfold-echo-void.text: Mirrorfold Echo Void — a darker chamber where sound and active sensor pulses return in layered duplicates from different apparent directions. Sparse reflective planes and deep Warp Black negative space make orientation difficult.

academy-observation-gallery.text: Academy observation gallery — long Core-facing window and suspended route displays above the navigation wing, used for course briefings and field-order handoffs. Clean Fleet architecture with visible working traffic beyond.
